call_distributed_init: call distributed_init to initialize the process group for multi-GPU or TPU distributed training
call_infer_init_method: call infer_init_method to auto-detect the distributed init method from Slurm or torch.distributed.launch env vars
call_all_gather_list: call all_gather_list to gather arbitrary picklable Python data from all workers into a single list
call_broadcast_object: call broadcast_object to broadcast an arbitrary Python object from one rank to all other workers
call_all_reduce_dict: call all_reduce_dict to all-reduce a dictionary of tensor and scalar values across distributed workers
